core_obligations: Injectivity of the first arrow (proof lines 2995-3008): f^*N = O_X forces f_*f^*N = O_B; local triviality makes N -> f_*f^*N locally an isomorphism, hence N -> O_B is an isomorphism and N is trivial.

Kernel of the second arrow (proof lines 3010-3025): L trivial on each X_{B_i} gives trivializing sections whose differences are units f_ij (equality of Gamma groups by the pushforward assumption); the f_ij satisfy the cocycle condition, so they are a descent datum; the Descent chapter proposition yields N with trivializations and descent datum {f_ij}; full faithfulness gives f^*N = L.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to B = T by replacing B and X (proof lines 2990-2992).
Prove injectivity of Pic(T) -> Pic(X_T) via the pushforward assumption and local triviality (proof lines 2995-3008).
Build the cocycle of units f_ij from trivializing sections over an fppf covering (proof lines 3010-3022).
Descend to N by the Descent chapter proposition and conclude f^*N = L by full faithfulness (proof lines 3023-3025).
